prompts: Create a production transparent UI sprite atlas, not a screenshot. Reference image is the APPROVED visual style and must be followed closely: refined mobile puzzle cream/peach faces, dark muted plum outlines, small warm bottom bevel, mint switches. Exactly 12 isolated assets arranged in a regular 4 columns by 3 rows grid, one centered asset per equal grid cell, ample transparent gutters. Uniform stroke weight. No labels or letters anywhere. Row1: (1) mint pill toggle ON cream circular knob right, (2) muted plum pill toggle OFF cream knob left, (3) mint round completion badge cream checkmark, (4) amber round skipped badge cream double chevron. Row2: (1) solid plum musical note, (2) solid plum speaker with two curved sound waves, (3) solid plum phone with small vibration marks, (4) plum outline globe. Row3: (1) empty wide cream settings row with ONLY a very fine light caramel outline, NO dark outline and NO bottom extruded lip, (2) empty cream pill language selector fine caramel outline, (3) solid plum movie-strip/play icon, (4) solid plum X close icon with gently rounded terminals. Icons match the reference's simple confident forms, subtle soft shading only on switches and badges, no glows. All assets strictly front-facing top-down UI, fully transparent background, no frame around the sheet, no ornamental decorations. This atlas will be sliced by grid coordinates in Unity. Reference image only provides style, do not reproduce its scene or text.

Edit this production UI atlas preserving exact 4x3 grid, positions, silhouettes and transparent background. Clean ALL stray white/fuzzy pixels outside the two cream controls at bottom left: they must have immaculate smooth antialiased edges and absolutely transparent surrounding pixels. Reduce outlines of the two switches and the two circular status badges in row 1: replace their thick dark purple rim with a fine muted teal rim on mint assets and a fine caramel rim on the amber badge. Their outer outline should be only 2-3 pixels at this resolution. Make top row switches and badges flatter and less inflated, with modest highlights matching a refined cream/plum mobile puzzle UI. Do not change bottom row icons or middle row icons. Keep all 12 assets, no labels, no extra shapes, same transparent background. Cream settings row must have fine peach outline only and no purple rim, no drop shadow. Cream pill selector same fine peach outline.
